fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2026-08-10, the complainant paid Rs. 40,000 to a person who promised a job placement, but no appointment order was provided and calls went unanswered. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2026-08-08 at approximately 17:05. Malathi Murugan submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000027. Nithin Thangaraj (9000000252) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. The account reference SYN-ACC-100096 was noted in connection with the payment. The complainant alleged that Sanjay Velan may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000095. Items referenced in the complaint: transaction records.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim allegedly paid a fee for a job that was never provided.
fields.Keywords: job fraud, cheating, evening, suspect, transaction record, main street, witness, receiving account
